scope: read-only source audit; no execution or concurrency experiment claimed
result: Legitimate concurrent retirement/recreation ordering is sound. Source32 has a legacy missing-snapshot second-opener attempt; isolated source33 corrects it. No live-file tampering scope expansion needed.

findings.conclusion: Config mutation serialization plus post-install all-project Store.call barriers close the snapshot-read race. Retirement waits for remember_filter_adapters and Directory.reconcile on every project before returning or serving the next Config request. Old transactions complete first; queued Store.command reads current Config inside its transaction and rejects absent actor. The next Developer create therefore reads snapshots including all accepted earlier old-agent mutations.

prepare_moves freezes writers only on path moves; ordinary retirement does not require that freeze because its commit already performs the all-project drain barriers after persistent credential removal. Do not justify safety using the default Store.rename barrier alone, which would omit nondefault writers.

findings.criterion: hidden, archived, missing and corrupt snapshots
findings.conclusion: All registered projects are checked independently of owner admission, including after a match. Missing/corrupt snapshots fail closed. However absent legacy c.server_id plus missing default snapshot calls Projects.server bootstrap fallback, which attempts a writable DETS opener on the checkpoint. This violates the no-second-opener guard requirement despite failure-closed behavior. Source33 replaces that bootstrap call with configured or verified-snapshot server identity and validates Directory.server_id.

Mutation receipts key authenticated actor and persist indefinitely; additional checks include private delivery recipient/sender, publication author, subscription agent and pending job recipient. Asynchronous accepted work already has its original mutation receipt/job, so later completion cannot create an unguarded first ownership reference after successful retirement.

A current authorized Admin/Developer may replay its exact old create_agent receipt; it returns the stored result without a configuration/credential mutation. Receipt replay therefore cannot recreate a removed identity or overwrite an Admin reassignment. New IDs/commands still undergo current role, owner, revision, admission and retained-state checks.

limitations: Independent acceptance and cold restart experiments are owned by the acceptance agent; this report does not claim their outcomes.

A hash-valid same-identity snapshot manually rolled back while a live writer retains newer memory is not compared to live Store generation. That requires unsupported live state-file substitution; ordinary atomic persistence, committed relocation and offline paired restore do not produce it. If that adversary becomes in scope, use a generation-bound Store barrier/read rather than another checksum.
Do not remove/reorder the all-project commit drain barriers without adding an equivalent retirement/recreation fence.
Source31 remains frozen; this review does not admit, integrate or release source32.

subsequent_correction.scope: Source33 targeted actual-module open_file/2 trace unit probe PASS4: actual positive control then zero guard calls on healthy-unused, retained, missing and corrupt snapshots. Not a public legacy lifecycle claim.

later_registry_defect.summary: Separate Admin registry-null patch downgraded actual33 config to legacy mode;34 now rejects registry removal/rebinding in dry/apply/file paths, qualified6 groups with default/no-default and cold restarts.
